about: REE-265 step 0, every subject since REE-274: the ceilings of the work one answer may make, per state (tools/answercost.js; CI's "answer cost" job counts every state, tests/answercost.test.js holds the pure parts): fish, corals and sea slugs, each at 50, 500 and 3,000 answers, for a player in the middle of a session (the page's clock 30 s after the state's last answer), signed out. The players AND the data the page loads (every .json file) are the pinned tree's (answercost.js PLAYERS_AT, a commit of main), the code counted is the tree under test's, so neither a change of the draw nor a bot's refill of the photos moves a count; and a count is repeatable (REE-281: virtual clock, random numbers started over at each tick, every photo a 1 x 1 picture served at once, the page booted on About, which draws no question, and at rest before the quiz opens: the same state and seed give the same questions and the same count to a few calls, on a loaded machine too). Each ceiling is the largest count measured over the page's seeds 1 to 3 (the seeds change the questions drawn, by up to 2x on fish:3000), times the margin, rounded up to two significant digits, at least 100 calls. History: fish and corals at 3,000 were set on main after #1522, tightened when the units in play became a view of the state version (REE-265 step 3: fn:bonusCalc in place of fn:bonusList) and when the tree's score and the levels did (step 4: fn:lvStepCalc in place of fn:lvStep); all nine states were set again on the pinned players when REE-274 added the sea slugs and the corals at 50 and 500 and moved the counts to CI, and again, with the pinned data and the repeatable count, for REE-281 (twice: the second time for the boot, which asked another sequence from the third question under load); the storage reads (getCalls, getChars) of every state were tightened when the stored texts came to be compared once per task (REE-265: app.js freshSeen); every ceiling was set again when the boot's own question stopped being kept (REE-281, a third time: the first question was the boot's, which differed from one load to the next, and the questions that followed with it); the ceilings the views of the units met, the bars, the exam entries and the rank classes lowered were lowered, the others kept (REE-265: model.js introduced, genScore; app.js rankUnits, DATA_V). A step that lowers a count tightens its ceilings in the same PR: node tools/answercost.js --seed 1,2,3 --write-budget tools/answercost-budget.json --margin 1.25 (--states for the states it touches).
